nodes.content: Enable mobile manipulators to distinguish object slip from localization drift while maintaining contact during furniture repositioning.
requirements: Reposition unseen furniture within 5 cm in 90% of trials with intermittent visual occlusion.
Identify slip versus localization drift with 90% balanced accuracy without external tracking during execution.

nodes.content: Fuse tactile shear, wheel–arm odometry, and intermittent RGB-D in a contact-anchored graph estimating furniture pose, slip, and localization drift.
During 3-second RGB-D occlusions, can contact-anchored fusion distinguish gripper–furniture slip from localization drift?
Contact-frame tactile shear and wheel–arm residuals achieve ≥90% slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy during 3-second RGB-D occlusions.
Collect induced-slip and odometry-drift pushes; fit contact-anchored fusion and evaluate balanced accuracy across 3-second occlusions on unseen furniture.
Run OccludedPush-120 on unseen furniture with induced gripper slip or wheel-odometry bias during 3-second RGB-D blackouts; measure balanced accuracy.
On OccludedPush-120, contact-anchored fusion achieved 78% slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy during 3-second RGB-D blackouts, below 90%.
After 78% passive accuracy, phase-locked tactile shear from 2-mm contact-preserving probes will yield ≥90% slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy during 3-second occlusions.
Repeat OccludedPush-120 with 2-mm contact-preserving probes; compare phase-locked-shear balanced accuracy against the 78% passive baseline.
On OccludedPush-120, 2-mm probes raised slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy from 78% to 92% during 3-second RGB-D blackouts.
Adopt 2-mm contact-preserving probes for slip diagnosis: balanced accuracy rose from 78% passive to 92% on OccludedPush-120.
Integrate 2-mm probes into contact-anchored control; measure ≤5-cm repositioning success over 100 unseen-furniture trials with 3-second RGB-D blackouts.
ProbePush-v1 controller and 100-trial unseen-furniture log containing contact-probe traces, blackout intervals, endpoint errors, and slip-versus-drift predictions.
Can contact-anchored graph corrections keep final furniture pose within 5 cm in ≥90% of unseen-furniture pushes despite RGB-D blackouts?
ProbePush-v1 contact-anchored corrections achieve ≤5-cm endpoint error in ≥90% of unseen-furniture pushes with 3-second RGB-D blackouts.
Use wall-plane-anchored dual-hypothesis filtering of wrist wrench and wheel motion, with compliant pushes to preserve furniture contact.
Fit wall-plane-anchored dual-hypothesis filtering; benchmark 100 unseen-furniture pushes against ProbePush-v1 for 5-cm success and balanced accuracy under 3-second occlusions.
Use ProbePush-v1's log as baseline; run 100 wall-anchored pushes with 3-second blackouts, scoring 5-cm success and balanced accuracy.
WallPush-100 dataset pairs blackout-timed wrench and odometry traces with endpoint errors and slip-versus-drift labels for 100 wall-anchored pushes.
Audit WallPush-100 blackout and event labels, then score wall-anchored filtering against ProbePush-v1 on 5-cm success and balanced accuracy.
On WallPush-100, wall-anchored filtering achieved 84% within-5-cm success and 86% slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy, missing both 90% targets.
Does wall-plane misassociation at corners explain WallPush-100’s 84% placement success and 86% slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy?
Correcting corner wall-plane associations will raise WallPush-100 5-cm success and balanced accuracy from 84%/86% to ≥90%.
Audit WallPush-100 corner associations; rerun 100 pushes with corner-gated filtering and score corner-stratified 5-cm success and balanced accuracy.
Corner-gated WallPush-100 reruns raised 5-cm success from 84% to 92% and slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy from 86% to 91%.
Revive wall-anchored filtering with corner gating: WallPush-100 5-cm success and balanced accuracy rose from 84%/86% to 92%/91%.
Score ProbePush-v1’s 100-trial log and corner-gated WallPush-100 reruns for 5-cm success and slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy.
Across 100 unseen pushes each, ProbePush-v1 achieved 87% 5-cm success; corner-gated WallPush achieved 92% success and 91% balanced accuracy.
Fuse wrist contact acoustics and base IMU in a switching-state estimator to separate furniture slip from odometric drift during occlusion.
Can wrist acoustics and base IMU distinguish furniture slip from wheel vibration on carpet during 3-second RGB-D blackouts?
Calibrate contact-anchored fusion from ProbePush-v1 logs; compare against acoustic–IMU switching on 100 carpet pushes during 3-second blackouts via balanced accuracy.
On 100 carpet pushes, acoustic–IMU switching reached 93% slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy versus contact-anchored fusion’s 82% during 3-second blackouts.
Does acoustic–IMU switching’s 93% classification accuracy translate into ≥90% within-5-cm placement success on carpet during 3-second blackouts?
Using acoustic–IMU slip alerts for compliant-push correction yields ≥90% within-5-cm placement success on unseen carpeted furniture.
Integrate acoustic–IMU alerts into compliant pushing; test 100 unseen carpeted-furniture moves with 3-second blackouts and measure 5-cm success.
Calibrate contact-anchored control from ProbePush-v1 logs; compare 5-cm success against acoustic–IMU control on 100 unseen carpet pushes under 3-second blackouts.
On 100 unseen carpet pushes with 3-second blackouts, acoustic–IMU-assisted contact-anchored control achieved 92% within-5-cm success versus 84% unassisted.
Replicate the 92% carpet result across 100 noisy-room pushes, scoring 5-cm success and slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy during 3-second blackouts.
Across 100 noisy-room carpet pushes, acoustic–IMU-assisted control achieved 91% within-5-cm success and 90% slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy.
Adopt acoustic–IMU-assisted contact-anchored control: carpet balanced accuracy rose 82%→93%, placement success 84%→92%; noisy-room success/accuracy reached 91%/90%.
Can acoustic–IMU switching distinguish gripper slip from furniture-foot scraping and odometry drift on tile during 3-second RGB-D blackouts?
Calibrate corner-gated filtering on WallPush-100; compare it with acoustic–IMU switching on tile slip, scraping, and drift during 3-second blackouts.
On 100 tile pushes, corner-gated filtering achieved 92% balanced accuracy versus acoustic–IMU switching’s 79% amid furniture-foot scraping.
Gate corner-anchored and acoustic–IMU estimators by onboard floor-surface classification, sharing contact-constrained furniture pose updates during occlusion.
Can onboard surface gating retain ≥90% slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy and 5-cm placement success across carpet–tile transitions during occlusion?
Surface-gated fusion achieves ≥90% balanced accuracy and ≥90% within-5-cm success across carpet–tile transitions with 3-second RGB-D blackouts.
Train floor gating on onboard IMU spectra; test 100 unseen-furniture carpet–tile transitions with 3-second blackouts and score both targets.
Initialize estimator branches from ProbePush-v1 and WallPush-100 logs; test IMU-gated fusion on 100 carpet–tile pushes with 3-second blackouts.
TransitionPush-100 log records IMU floor gates, estimator switches, slip-versus-drift predictions, and endpoint errors for 100 carpet–tile blackout pushes.
Audit TransitionPush-100 gate timestamps and event labels; compute slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy and within-5-cm success against 90% thresholds.
TransitionPush-100 yielded 87% slip-versus-drift balanced accuracy and 88% within-5-cm success; both missed 90% during carpet–tile transitions.
Replacing hard floor gates with 0.5-second change-point blending will raise 87% balanced accuracy and 88% 5-cm success to ≥90%.
Use TransitionPush-100 timestamps to tune 0.5-second change-point blending; rerun 100 unseen carpet–tile pushes, measuring balanced accuracy and 5-cm success.
With 0.5-second change-point blending, transition pushes improved from 87% to 91% balanced accuracy and 88% to 92% 5-cm success.
Benchmark 0.5-second blended fusion against acoustic–IMU-assisted contact-anchored control on 100 carpet–tile pushes with 3-second blackouts, scoring both targets.
Across 100 held-out transitions, blended fusion achieved 91% balanced accuracy and 92% 5-cm success; acoustic-assisted contact anchoring achieved 88%/86%.
Adopt blended fusion: carpet favors acoustics, tile favors corner anchors; hard gating failed, transitions reached 91% balanced accuracy/92% 5-cm success.
Stratify from TransitionPush-100; test blended fusion on 200 unseen-furniture pushes under 3-second blackouts, measuring 5-cm success and balanced accuracy.
BlendPush-200 benchmark records unseen-furniture floor type, blackout intervals, estimator weights, slip/drift labels, and endpoint errors for 200 pushes.
